commercial.description:
Partitions: 
Dismantling of existing Gypsum/Glass/Wooden partitions wherever required and stacking debris within 10 meters from the work area. Providing and fixing skirting as per site requirement.

Brick Wall: 
Dismantling of existing brick wall and lintels where ever necessary and stacking the debris with a lead of 10mts away from the dismantled area and Repairs of the areas.

Column Cladding: 
Dismantling of existing column cladding wherever required, including stacking of debris within 10 meters from the dismantled area and making good the damaged areas after completion of work.

Wall Paneling: 
Dismantling of existing wall laminate and paneling wherever required, including stacking of debris within 10 meters from the dismantled area and making good the damaged areas after completion of work.

False ceiling: 
Dismantling of existing Gypsum/PVC/Grid false ceiling wherever required, including stacking of debris within 10 meters from the dismantled area and making good the damaged areas after completion of work.

Furniture: 
Removing of existing furniture, partitions, wiring, switch boards, etc., and stacking the materials at ground floor as per site requirement.

Carpet: 
Removing of existing carpet flooring including adhesive residue wherever required, and stacking of debris within 10 meters from the work area as per site instructions.

Lights: 
Removing of existing light fittings wherever required and stacking the materials as per site requirement.
Shifting of debris/materials such as carpet, gypsum material, glass partitions, cabin tables, etc., from 13th floor to ground floor as per site requirement.
Carting of dismantled debris from the stacked area and disposing the same approximately 10 km away from the site using tractor vehicle.
Removing of existing doors and door frames and stacking the materials at the location instructed by the site in-charge within 100 meters from the dismantled area.

Pedestal Removal:
Carefully dismantling and removing the existing pedestal from the site, including shifting debris and disposing of waste materials as per site conditions.

Granite for Counter Top (Pantry Area): Providing and fixing granite countertop with edge polishing and moulding, fixed over plywood/WPC on MS base frame using approved adhesives. The rate includes all materials, hardware, fittings, labour, and installation, complete as per design and instructions of the Architect/Engineer.

Plumbing Works
Providing and laying of pipeline for pantry connection from 11th floor to ground floor, including all required fittings, supports, cutting, chasing, jointing, testing and fixing complete as per site requirement.
SS Sink- 24"X18"X8" - AS per selection
Sink Cock : Brand: Parryware/Cera and other accessories

Drainage Pipeline:
Floor chipping for drain pipeline from pantry room to duct area, including debris removal. Cutting and refixing of metal door for 6" opening as per site requirement.

Flooring Work near the entrance:
Floor cutting and making new flooring for mat and floor finish, including skirting work at dismantled brick wall area as per site requirement.
Providing and fixing of trap door including all necessary hardware, fittings and finishing complete as per site requirement.
